text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - us-east-1 hosted inference nodes are experiencing repeated restarts and elevated 5xx rates for streaming endpoints. Investigating root cause. Impact: ~6% of requests, increased tail latency for streams.

lucy (oncall): ack, I'm on it. seeing OOM restarts on a subset of inference-pool-1 pods. collecting logs now.

omar (runtime): curious — any recent rollout that touched KV cache TTL? I pushed a microchange to default TTL last night to address stale-kv hits.

maria (support): flagged high-touch customers experiencing disconnects. CS notified, holding for status page link.

eng-oncall: dump from node-3 shows repeated growth in memory associated with kv-cache entries, not evicting. attaching snippet.

infra-bot: ```
# kubectl -n hosted logs inference-pool-1-node-3 -c runtime | tail -n 40
E0423 12:14:02 runtime.go:421] kv-cache: entry count=541234, total_mem=4.6Gi, ttl_policy=never_expire
panic: runtime: out of memory
```

lucy (oncall): confirmed regression window ~ 02:00 UTC after the TTL tuning job. rolling a config rollback to previous TTL across pool-1 nodes now.

omar (runtime): rolling restart started (coord via autoscaler-safe). plan: restart 10% at a time, keep canary for 2m, monitor error rate. fallback: pin requests to smaller model variant if restarts spike.

support-ops: posting to status page now: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/177984. message: "Investigating elevated errors in us-east-1 for hosted inference streaming. Partial customer impact. Mitigation in progress."

maria (support): CS updates queued. customers impacted: 4 enterprise customers, several PLG apps. shared mitigations and ETA ~15-30m.

lucy (oncall): after first 3 restarts, error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2%. continuing staged restart. monitoring mem/cpu and tail latency.

omar (runtime): deployed hotfix to TTL enforcement code to reclaim expired keys proactively. will observe for 15m.

infra-bot: metric snapshot: kv_cache_live_entries (us-east-1) 5m avg: 540k -> 42k after rollout phase 1. 5xx_rate streaming: 5.9% -> 0.9%

support-ops: updated status page with "mitigation in progress, partial mitigation observed" and contact for enterprise support.

maria (support): customers acknowledged, one requests postmortem. logging that.

lucy (oncall): continuing to finish restarts across nodes. if stable for 20m we'll mark as mitigated. RCA to follow (likely TTL regression + no safety cap in eviction path).

omar (runtime): noted for postmortem: add hard cap on kv-cache memory and circuit-breaker to force eviction when mem exceeds threshold.

sre-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/177984 - Mitigation shows decreased errors; ongoing verification.

lucy (oncall): RESOLVED: Rolling restarts + hotfix completed at 2026-03-23T14:30:20Z. streaming 5xx back to baseline. Creating follow-up RCA thread and action tracker. :white_check_mark:
